question: Organisms belonging to the phylum ______ are also called ‘flatworms’.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Platyhelminthes.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• Animals belonging to the **phylum Platyhelminthes **are also called flatworms due to their dorsoventrally flattened bodies.
 
• Examples are a **liver fluke, tapeworm, etc.**
 
• They are** found as endoparasites in human beings.**
